Definition: to gaze at or about (properly, for help); by implication, to inspect, consider, compassionate, be nonplussed (as looking around in amazement) or bewildered
BiblicalUsage: 1) to look at or to, regard, gaze at or about; 1a) (Qal) to gaze at, regard, behold, look about; 1b) (Hiphil) to look away, cause gaze to turn away; 1c) (Hithpael) to look in dismay, gaze about (in anxiety)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
